title: Sunday Roast
desc: Cooking myths, surprise origins & drinks you thought you knew

questions.q: Most 'wasabi' served outside Japan is actually made from what?
Peanuts grow underground — are they nuts, seeds, or legumes?
questions.a: Legumes (same family as lentils and chickpeas)

questions.q: What was tomato ketchup originally sold as in the 1830s?
questions.a: Medicine — marketed as a cure for diarrhoea

questions.q: Which country consumes the most coffee per person?

questions.a: Medieval bakers added an extra to avoid harsh penalties for selling underweight loaves

questions.q: White chocolate doesn't contain which ingredient that all other chocolate does?
questions.a: Cocoa solids — it's only cocoa butter, sugar, and milk

questions.q: Honey found in Egyptian tombs over 3,000 years old was still edible — true or false?
Strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries aren't actually berries. Name a fruit that IS a true berry.
questions.a: Bananas, grapes, avocados, tomatoes, or watermelons all qualify

questions.q: The spice saffron is worth more by weight than gold — what part of the flower is it?
questions.a: The stigma (thread-like strands inside a crocus flower)

questions.q: Fanta was invented in which country during WWII, and why?
questions.a: Nazi Germany — Coca-Cola couldn't import syrup ingredients due to a trade embargo
